notes: All 20 Penn Clubs entries in batch 17 were read through the directory API. 20 records written, 0 searches, 45 fetches (within the 60 cap; budget not exhausted). Verdicts: 20 publish, of which 3 are held back by design with status unknown and no summary, categories or interests (Quiz Bowl at Penn, Skeptic's Dinner, Service Link), because their directory status fields read INACTIVE while the active flag is true. Status counts: active 3 (Reach-A-Peer Helpline, REACH at Penn, Science Olympiad), probably_active 13, dormant 1 (Science Policy and Diplomacy Group, whose own site's newest dated items are 2019 to 2020), unknown 3. Conventions used: the Penn Clubs label UNDER REVIEW was read as a registration label, not activity. Directory active flag true with no dated item gives probably_active. Directory application_required values 1 were read as yes; values 2 to 5 were read as unclear, and the rules for unclear values are in each record's basis. Where the listing's text and its flag disagree (Social Deduction Club), the text was used and the conflict is in the record notes. Dates without a year were not given a year: Road2Research (September 18), Simply Chaos (September 6), Science Olympiad registration dates, and the journal submission window. Personal contacts were left out: named student contacts or personal student emails on Service Link, Simply Chaos and Skeptic's Dinner, and a named person's email on Renewal College Fellowship. Club emails were used instead. The Reach-A-Peer helpline phone numbers are the club's public help lines and are recorded. Renewal's listed website redirected to an unrelated address and was not followed. The Ready@20 social links belong to First Love Center and are recorded as listed. Summaries were written fresh from the directory and club pages; no copied runs.
